cases.answer:
To enter players on your roster:

1. Go to the Captain Tools section on your Captain Dashboard.
2. Click Manage Roster.

4. In the pop-up, your home community will be preselected; use the drop-down to view available players, their eligibility status, and DUPR ratings.

cases.question: How do I enter match scores?

evidence.documentTitle: LWRPC-Captains Guide to the LMS
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide

cases.answer:
To enter match scores:

1. Open the match and click the red “Enter Match Scores” button. It is available only on or after the scheduled match date.
2. Select the players for each game using the dropdowns, normally using the saved Match Setup team; if players changed, choose the correct player individually.
3. Enter the scores in each game block.
4. Click Submit. The system checks for errors before saving.
5. The opposing captain then receives a verification request, reviews the scores, and either verifies or disputes them. The visiting captain must verify promptly so results can be entered into DUPR before the end of the weekend.

Important limits: if an entire match date is forfeited/canceled due to weather or scheduling conflicts, do not enter it in the system; contact League Management at info@lwrpickleballclub.com. For individual game forfeits or retirements, refer to the official League Rules. Ineligible players cannot be selected, and score fields are blocked for a line with an eligibility issue.

sources.citation: LWRPC-Captains Guide to the LMS — Page 13
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide — ENTER/VERIFY SCORES — Page 9

cases.question: Does the weekday dupr league use rally scoring

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
No—not generally. The weekday DUPR league’s governing default scoring method is Standard Scoring under current USA Pickleball rules, unless a particular game or match format expressly requires Rally Scoring.

The supplied weekday exception is limited to the 9.1 division Picklebreaker™: only when the match is tied 2–2 after all preceding rounds, that Picklebreaker™ is one game to 15, win by 2, using Rally Scoring.

cases.question: Does PrimeTime use Rally Scoring?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
No, not generally. PrimeTime uses Standard Scoring by default. Rally Scoring is used only when a particular game or match format expressly requires it.

For PrimeTime, the supplied express exception is the Picklebreaker™: only when the match is tied 2–2 after all preceding rounds, the Picklebreaker™ is one game to 15, win by 2, using Rally Scoring.

cases.question: Do regular PrimeTime games use Rally Scoring?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
No. Regular PrimeTime games use Standard Scoring, the governing default scoring method, unless a particular game or match format expressly requires Rally Scoring.

The PrimeTime Rally Scoring exception supplied is only for the Picklebreaker™: when the match is tied 2–2 after all preceding rounds, the Picklebreaker is one game to 15, win by 2, using Rally Scoring.

cases.question: Does the PrimeTime Picklebreaker use Rally Scoring?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
Yes—but only the PrimeTime Picklebreaker uses Rally Scoring, and only when the match is tied 2–2 after all preceding rounds. It is one game to 15 points, win by two.

The governing default is Standard Scoring for all games unless a particular game or match format expressly requires Rally Scoring.
